behavior: A checksummed github-archive source extracts one exact declared regular-file member from zip and tar.gz assets.
Invalid, missing, duplicate, directory, symlink or unsupported archive members fail without replacing the installed binary.
A ts-bridge-client role selects the pinned ts-bridge tool while non-role machines plan no bridge install.
The role owns a Gitea-only Git proxy drop-in and removes it when the role is removed; GitHub remains direct.
Doctor distinguishes version drift, listener readiness and TLS-valid destination reachability without credential output.
A second install and converge report zero changes, and bridge-down behavior is explicit.
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/tools -run '^TestInstallGitHubArchiveSecondRunSkipsWithoutFetch$' -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestInstallGitHubArchiveSecondRunSkipsWithoutFetch' && go test ./internal/cmd -run '^TestConverge_TsBridgeClientSecondRunIsZero$' -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestConverge_TsBridgeClientSecondRunIsZero' && go test ./internal/doctor -run '^TestCheckTsBridgeListenerDownIsExplicit$' -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestCheckTsBridgeListenerDownIsExplicit'

behavior: Older dotf binaries explicitly skip the unknown archive source without blocking unrelated tools.
